_comment: The known answer for each case. The pipeline sees the diff and nothing else — no file list, no repository, no expectation file — so this is the answer the runs are measured against. `expect` is the one weakness the diff contains; `cwe` lists every class name that names THAT weakness, because the pipeline does not use one class per weakness (it named the same OAuth weakness CWE-352 in two runs and CWE-287 in the third). `lines` narrows a rule to a range of the new file; without it the rule covers the whole file. `must_not_report` are the near-misses planted next to the weakness: safe code where a finding of that class is a false positive.

must_not_report.why: the balance query in the module next to it is a parameterized template tag

race-ownership.what: the ownership check and the money movement are separated by awaits, so the owner can change in between (CWE-362, a race on the owner of the wallet)

must_not_report.why: the session lookup is a parameterized template tag
the client secret comes from the environment

oauth-state.what: the OAuth callback stores the `state` it was given and never compares it with the session, so it accepts a state it did not issue (CWE-352)

must_not_report.why: the title reaches the shell through `env:` and a quoted variable, so its content is never expanded a second time; the other step labels with a fixed name

workflow-shell.what: one step interpolates the pull request title straight into a shell line, so a pull request title runs commands (CWE-78)

must_not_report.why: the handler next to it binds its parameters
every query in that file is a parameterized template tag

sql-concat.what: the report lookup pastes the `id` parameter into the SQL text (CWE-89)

must_not_report.why: the third handler resolves the path and checks that it stays inside the directory
the name is a generated uuid and the type is allowlisted

path-traversal.what: two download handlers join a request parameter onto the files directory without checking where it points (CWE-22)

must_not_report.why: the second function logs the length of the token, not the token
the service key comes from the environment

token-log.what: the caller writes the whole bearer token into the log (CWE-532)

must_not_report.why: the two routes next to it call `requireRole`
the role lookup is a parameterized template tag

missing-authorization.what: the route that deactivates a user checks nobody's role, while the routes next to it call `requireRole` (CWE-862)
